scope: Diagnostic revelation of exact timing only. This is not a practical timing search, independent validation, or an ordinary receiver integration.
required_checks: Original local binary SHA must match; no cross-host/compiler waveform identity assumption.
Oracle start stays inside the independently configured physical start prior, so min/max public calendar bounds and capture padding remain unchanged.
Regenerated endpoint_truth, Gaussian teacher, six seed roots, source format and complete sampled calendar must match the nominal reference.

signal_energy.f64 and received_energy.f64 must match byte-for-byte; source/pre/post-selective energy, intervals and validity must match. Changed means/Grams/noisy projections are intended receiver-template changes.
All actual reports must bind their exact source manifest/array hashes and use identical FP64 receiver methods, widths/windows and calibrated family.
No noise-only operational calibration or blind timing-search result follows from an oracle selected using hidden simulation timing.
limits: Only public template arrival changes; no oscillator, CFO, sample-clock, phase, physical path, waveform, power, duration, source bit, epoch or seed is optimized.
The same four physical/noise realizations per profile/model are compared twice; never pool nominal and oracle as independent trials.
The fixed original sampled C/N0 is used: 6dB-Hz for high10, 8dB-Hz for high30; conditional 8/10dB screens are distinct observations.
If waveform/energy equality fails, retain the discrepancy and do not claim timing is causally isolated.
